note: Released 5.1.0 receipt. apply_evalplan_fill gained a phase selector so the driver-free clean path (fill + core finalize) is reachable through the MCP surface in one call. The final observed contract hash is 429cb6706323e762.

addedInputParameters.name: phase
addedInputParameters.description: How far the recipe runs. 'structural' = confident deletions only; 'all' (default; the prior behaviour) = structural + per-region content fills; 'clean' = 'all' plus core's deterministic post-fill cleanup (title/teacher/정의적 fills, instruction-scaffolding + orphan prune, red-strip, blue->black recolor, caption strip), surfaced under contentReport.finalize. An invalid phase fails closed with EVALPLAN_PHASE_INVALID.

coreDependency.failClosed: phase not in {structural, all, clean} raises EVALPLAN_PHASE_INVALID before any core call. The released distribution requires python-hwpx>=4.2.0, the first public core with the clean branch; resolver validation prevents the stale-core degradation path in a valid 5.1.0 install.

proof: Holding classification, counts, domains, and every other tool fixed, the canonical payload delta is confined to the dependency/version floors and apply_evalplan_fill: its inputSchema gains one optional string property (phase, default 'all'), which is not added to the required list. No tool is added, removed, renamed, or reclassified; the output schema is unchanged (contentReport is a free-form object that already carries the new finalize report); mutation/profile/skill-required flags are unchanged. The observed released contract hash is c2cd81fdb3089bae -> 429cb6706323e762.
